claims.rationale: The claim is a general experimental-unit constraint that the population contract enforces; the scientific statement itself is not a standalone AI-system performance hypothesis.
The project-specific structural-lineage leakage graph needs a sealed outer-family split and one-pass transfer protocol before its consequence can be tested.

The exact-bound integrated release now executes a complete 20-instance receipt-only traversal and satisfies the parameterized-runner infrastructure gate, but it emits no estimator endpoints and has no shifted outer-lineage evaluation; parameter-shift performance still needs role-disjoint fitting and calibration plus a powered endpoint comparison.
Risk-coverage behavior needs trained probability-emitting candidate and null artifacts plus an instance-disjoint calibration protocol.
